description: Redrob OS dependency pins: base image tag, downloaded artifacts in image/pins.env, GitHub Actions SHAs. Weekly, never automerged; a human merges after PR CI (podman build + bootc lint) is green.

customManagers.description: image/base.env -- BASE_TAG follows the Fedora major of the kinoite base image (44 -> 45). Major bumps are a deliberate release, so they get their own PR and never automerge.

image/pins.env -- a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above `NAME_VERSION=` makes that pin updatable. Renovate bumps only the version; the matching NAME_SHA256 must be recomputed by hand (PR CI fails on the stale hash until it is), see docs/ci.md.
Container images pinned by digest inside workflow `env:` blocks (bootc-image-builder in release.yml).

packageRules.description: Base image major bump is a release decision; keep it visibly separate.
Pinned downloads: one PR per artifact so the hash can be recomputed per PR.
